speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Cancer with Malignant Ascites and Pleural Effusion. The combination of a large ovarian mass, significant abdominal girth increase, shortness of breath (likely due to ascites compressing the diaphragm or a pleural effusion), and fatigue without weight loss is highly suggestive of advanced ovarian malignancy.
